name: Moka Pot
summary: Stovetop brewer that produces strong, concentrated coffee close to espresso in character.

steps.title: Fill the base
steps.instruction: Fill the bottom chamber with hot water up to just below the pressure release valve.
steps.tip: Starting with hot water reduces time on heat and prevents a metallic taste.

steps.title: Fill the basket
steps.instruction: Fill the funnel basket with coffee and level it off without tamping.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.instruction: Insert the basket, screw the top chamber on firmly, and place the pot on medium-low heat with the lid open.

steps.title: Brew
steps.instruction: Listen and watch for coffee to begin flowing into the top chamber.
steps.tip: A steady, hissing gurgle means you're near the end — that's when it starts pulling steam, not coffee.

steps.title: Remove from heat
steps.instruction: As soon as you hear a sputtering hiss, remove from heat immediately to avoid a burnt, bitter taste.

steps.title: Cool the base and serve
steps.instruction: Run the base briefly under cool water to stop extraction, then pour and serve.
